review_horizon: multi-decade obligations with century-scale replacement awareness

obligation_horizon.finding: Retention horizons are documented per artifact class but not yet summarized in one durable obligation register.

stable_core.evidence: Provider-neutral artifact corpus and deterministic CLI contracts
stable_core.finding: Core artifacts are portable and provider adapters remain replaceable.

pace_layers.evidence: Core, framework, addon, and provider-adapter package boundaries
pace_layers.finding: Package layers change at different rates, but their supported change cadences are not yet stated as policy.
pace_layers.action: Document change cadence and compatibility expectations for each pace layer.

dependency_inventory.finding: Software dependencies are inventoried; institutional and hosted-service dependencies need explicit ownership.
dependency_inventory.action: Add non-software dependencies to the inventory.

replacement_points.evidence: Provider registry, storage adapters, web resource resolver
replacement_points.finding: Models, providers, stores, formats, and index engines expose explicit replacement seams.

stewardship.evidence: Repository ownership and CODEOWNERS-equivalent project policy
stewardship.finding: Long-horizon successor stewardship and key-custody transfer are not rehearsed.

degradation.evidence: Offline fallback, NOT RUN states, provider degradation metadata
degradation.finding: Most optional services degrade explicitly; hosted discovery and signing-loss modes need a consolidated runbook.

audit_evidence.evidence: Signed commits, release evidence, provenance exports, activity logs
audit_evidence.finding: Auditable evidence is available with integrity state and provenance.

meaning_preservation.evidence: ADRs, issue links, research references, schemas
meaning_preservation.finding: Decision context is strong, but meaning-package minimum fields are not yet enforced across every artifact type.
meaning_preservation.action: Define and lint a minimum meaning package.

dependencies.name: Fortemi Core index
dependencies.replacement_point: artifact index adapters and full-v1 export
